fun_facts: Drew Lock’s hometown is Lee’s Summit, Missouri, and he attended Lee’s Summit High School.
Drew Lock was recruited to play basketball and played it at the AAU level, too.
Friends and family once called Drew Lock “Bieber,” because of his big mop of hair.
Drew Lock set an SEC record with 44 touchdown passes as a junior in 2017.
Drew Lock finished his Missouri career with 12,193 passing yards and 99 touchdown passes, both ranking second in school history.
